raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Honor requested FP8 activations in Humming dense linear layers on SM100–SM119, including MXFP8 group-32/E8M0 schemas, instead of falling back to BF16. Bump `humming-kernels` to 0.1.19 for the required dense-tuner correctness fix ([humming#178](https://github.com/vllm-project/humming/pull/178)).

## Claims

- Quark MXFP4/MXFP6 checkpoints requesting FP8 dynamic activations (including MXFP6/MXFP8 requests, converted to FP8 E4M3) now actually run FP8 activations in dense linear layers on SM100/SM103. Previously these were silently downgraded to BF16 by two gates in `check_and_fallback_input_schema`: a blanket sub-16-bit "deprecated" predicate on SM100–SM119, and an SM120-only exception for the MXFP8-style group-32/E8M0 schema.
- MXFP6 GEMMs are 1.4–1.9× faster at decode batch sizes and ~1.7× at the measured prefill size (B300, CUDA-graph replay device time).
- Wikitext perplexity stays within the existing CI tolerance on a real MXFP6 checkpoint. MoE grouped GEMMs keep the BF16 fallback on SM100–SM119.

## Validation

### Schema tests

`pytest tests/quantization/test_humming_mxfp4_block_fp8.py`: **19/19 passed** (CPU, SM version mocked).

New test cases fail on base for the intended reasons: `test_mxfp8_activation_honored_from_sm100[100/103]` resolves to BF16 without this change, and `test_moe_path_keeps_fp8_gate_on_sm100` requires the new `allow_fp8_sm100` argument. `test_moe_expert_selection_keeps_fp8_gate_on_sm100` constructs a real `HummingMoEMethod` and verifies the activation key handed to expert selection is gated identically (it catches the constructor call site missing the flag — fixed in the follow-up commit). The tests also pin unchanged SM90/SM120 behavior and the retained FP4 gate on SM100.

CI note: the broad `tests/quantization/` Buildkite job is currently commented out upstream (pending a torchao pin) and the Humming lm-eval steps are marked TEMPORARY, so this file is not selected by any active step — the same status it had before this PR. Happy to wire it into an active step if reviewers prefer.

### Kernel timings

B300 (SM103), humming-kernels 0.1.19, MXFP6 E2M3 weights with group-32/E8M0 scales; CUDA-graph replay device time (the mode V1 decode serves in).

| Shape (N, K) | M | BF16 act (µs) | FP8 act (µs) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 17408, 5120 (27B gate/up) | 16 | 24.6 | 14.4 |
| 17408, 5120 | 128 | 28.7 | 18.1 |
| 17408, 5120 | 1024 | 129.2 | 86.1 |
| 17408, 5120 | 8192 | 1154.2 | 664.8 |
| 10240, 8192 (70B qkv) | 32 | 32.1 | 17.0 |
| 57344, 8192 (70B gate/up) | 32 | 127.6 | 73.3 |
| 8192, 28672 (70B down) | 32 | 70.3 | 41.8 |

### End-to-end serving

`vllm-project/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-2-layers-mxfp6`, 1×B300, 256 output tokens/request, default (multiprocess) engine:

| Batch size | Base tok/s (ITL) | This PR tok/s (ITL) |
|---|---|---|
| 32 | 16449 (1.95 ms) | 16785 (1.91 ms) |
| 256 | 60038 mean, 59644–60722 (n=3) | 59153 mean, 58099–59905 (n=3) |

bs=256 is within run-to-run noise: on this 2-layer test model the quantized GEMMs are only ~7% of a decode step, so the kernel-level wins above barely move the e2e needle here; they compound on real models where MLP/attention GEMMs dominate. The e2e runs primarily validate that the FP8 path works end-to-end under CUDA graphs with no serving regression.

Profiler evidence that the FP8 path is engaged end-to-end: with this PR the `process_input_kernel` (activation quant) runs and total Humming GEMM device time drops 6038 µs → 4310 µs (+243 µs quant) over the same profiled window.

### Accuracy

Wikitext perplexity on `fxmarty/qwen1.5_moe_a2.7b_chat_w_fp6_e3m2_a_fp6_e3m2`, same setup as `test_ocp_mx_wikitext_correctness` (CI reference 10.6 ± 0.1):

| Configuration | Perplexity |
|---|---:|
| Base (BF16 activations) | 10.519 |
| This PR (FP8 dense activations) | 10.579 |

### Reproduction

<details>

Layer-level timing and schema checks: see `tests/quantization/test_humming_mxfp4_block_fp8.py` for the schema matrix; kernel timings were measured by capturing a single `QuarkOCP_MX` linear layer's `apply_weights` in a `torch.cuda.CUDAGraph` and timing replay (200 iters) per shape above.

E2E: `LLM(model="vllm-project/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-2-layers-mxfp6", max_model_len=4096, gpu_memory_utilization=0.85)`, greedy, 32/256 prompts × 256 output tokens. Accuracy: `lm_eval.simple_evaluate(model="vllm", tasks="wikitext", batch_size=64, model_args={pretrained, dtype=auto, add_bos_token=True, gpu_memory_utilization=0.7, cudagraph_capture_sizes=[16]})` — mirrors the existing CI test.

</details>

## Details

Root cause: the gates date from before Humming had performant FP8 on SM10X ("Humming has not yet implemented high-performance FP8 computation on SM10X and SM11X"). As of humming-kernels 0.1.18/0.1.19 the dense path has native FP8 UMMA support — block-scaled (mxf8f6f4) for MX-style group-32/E8M0 scales, epilogue-scaled for per-token/per-channel — and it is faster than the BF16 path at every measured batch size under CUDA graphs.

This PR exempts FP8 dtypes from the dense-path deprecation and lowers the MXFP8 groupwise exception to SM100. The MoE call sites (expert selection in `HummingMoEMethod.__init__` and weight processing in `utils/humming/moe.py`) pass `allow_fp8_sm100=False` because Humming's grouped-GEMM FP8 path on SM100 is not yet validated (the two-CTA tuner bug below was found and fixed on the dense path; the MoE path has not been exercised). FP4 and other sub-16-bit dtypes keep their gates; SM90 and SM120+ behavior is unchanged.

The pin bump to 0.1.19 is required: 0.1.18's SM100 dense tuner could emit invalid two-CTA UMMA configs (`block_m % 16 != 0`), crashing e.g. a 6144×2048 MXFP6 + FP8-activation layer at engine startup on SM103 (fixed upstream in [humming#178](https://github.com/vllm-project/humming/pull/178)).

Tradeoffs: in eager mode the FP8 path adds ~70 µs/call of Python dispatch overhead (Humming's `process_input`), the same overhead the already-ungated per-token FP8 path pays on SM90; under CUDA graphs it disappears. FP8 E4M3 activations add quantization noise vs BF16 — measured impact is within the existing CI tolerance (see Accuracy).

Caveat for developers flipping this code path in place: vLLM's AOT compile-cache key does not include the resolved activation schema or the humming version, so reusing a warm cache across this change under the same vLLM version string can load a stale artifact and fail with a size/stride assert. Clear the compile cache when switching; release upgrades are unaffected (the version string is part of the key).

Related PRs:

- [#59460](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59460) makes activation-quantization fallbacks explicit/strict; complementary, does not un-gate FP8 on SM100.
- [#61666](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61666) adds compressed-tensors MXFP6 support; orthogonal (these checkpoints route here once supported).
- [#64802](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64802) bumps humming-kernels to 0.1.19 independently; this PR's pin bump will be dropped if that lands first.

AI assistance: this PR was developed with AI assistance (Kimi Code); Codex helped draft this description.

files.patch:
@@ -30,4 +30,4 @@ quack-kernels==0.6.5  # Required by MSA
 tokenspeed-mla==2.0.3; platform_system == "Linux"
 
 # Humming kernels for quantization gemm
-humming-kernels[cu13]==0.1.18
+humming-kernels[cu13]==0.1.19

@@ -153,3 +153,190 @@ def test_checkpoint_mxfp8_runs_as_block_fp8_on_hopper(
 
     assert str(schema.a_dtype) == "float8e4m3"
     assert schema.input_scale_group_size == expected_group_size
+
+
+def _mxfp6_weight_schema():
+    from vllm.utils.humming import BaseWeightSchema
+
+    return BaseWeightSchema.from_config(
+        {
+            "quant_method": "humming",
+            "dtype": "float6e2m3",
+            "scale_dtype": "float8e8m0",
+            "group_size": 32,
+            "weight_scale_type": "group",
+        }
+    )
+
+
+def _resolve_input_schema(monkeypatch, capability, activation_key, **kwargs):
+    from unittest.mock import patch
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.humming import (
+        check_and_fallback_input_schema,
+        quant_key_to_input_schema,
+    )
+    from vllm.platforms.interface import DeviceCapability
+
+    class _Device:
+        sm_version = capability
+
+    with (
+        patch(
+            "vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.humming.schema"
+            ".current_platform"
+        ) as platform_mock,
+        patch("humming.schema.humming.current_device", _Device()),
+    ):
+        platform_mock.get_device_capability.return_value = DeviceCapability(
+            capability // 10, capability % 10
+        )
+        return check_and_fallback_input_schema(
+            _mxfp6_weight_schema(),
+            quant_key_to_input_schema(activation_key),
+            param_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not has_humming(), reason="humming is not installed")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "capability,expect_fp8",
+    [
+        (90, False),  # WGMMA has no block-scaled MX path: keep BF16 (wna16)
+        (100, True),
+        (103, True),
+        (120, True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_mxfp8_activation_honored_from_sm100(monkeypatch, capability, expect_fp8):
+    """An MXFP8 activation request (FP8 E4M3, group-32, E8M0 scales) next to
+    MXFP6 weights must reach the Humming kernel on SM100+ instead of being
+    downgraded to BF16; SM90 keeps the BF16 (wna16) fallback."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+        kMxfp8Dynamic,
+    )
+    from vllm.utils.humming import dtypes as humming_dtypes
+
+    resolved = _resolve_input_schema(monkeypatch, capability, kMxfp8Dynamic)
+    if expect_fp8:
+        assert resolved.a_dtype == humming_dtypes.float8e4m3
+        assert resolved.input_scale_group_size == 32
+    else:
+        assert resolved.a_dtype is None or resolved.a_dtype.num_bits == 16
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not has_humming(), reason="humming is not installed")
+def test_moe_path_keeps_fp8_gate_on_sm100(monkeypatch):
+    """The MoE call site passes allow_fp8_sm100=False: humming's grouped-GEMM
+    path is not validated for FP8 activations on SM100-SM119, so it must keep
+    the BF16 fallback even though dense linear honors FP8 there."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+        kMxfp8Dynamic,
+    )
+
+    resolved = _resolve_input_schema(
+        monkeypatch, 100, kMxfp8Dynamic, allow_fp8_sm100=False
+    )
+    assert resolved.a_dtype is None or resolved.a_dtype.num_bits == 16
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not has_humming(), reason="humming is not installed")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "capability,expect_fp8_key",
+    [(100, None), (120, kMxfp8Dynamic)],
+)
+def test_moe_expert_selection_keeps_fp8_gate_on_sm100(
+    monkeypatch, capability, expect_fp8_key
+):
+    """HummingMoEMethod must resolve the activation key for expert selection
+    with the same SM100 FP8 gate as weight processing: on SM100-SM119 an MXFP8
+    activation request falls back to BF16 (key None), keeping expert selection
+    consistent with the BF16 input schema the weights are prepared for;
+    SM120+ honors FP8."""
+    from unittest.mock import patch
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.activation import MoEActivation
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.config import (
+        FusedMoEConfig,
+        FusedMoEParallelConfig,
+        RoutingMethodType,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import humming as humming_module
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.humming import (
+        HummingLayerQuantizationConfig,
+        HummingMoEMethod,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.humming import (
+        quant_key_to_input_schema,
+    )
+    from vllm.platforms.interface import DeviceCapability
+
+    class _Device:
+        sm_version = capability
+
+    moe_config = FusedMoEConfig(
+        num_experts=8,
+        experts_per_token=2,
+        hidden_dim=128,
+        intermediate_size=256,
+        num_local_experts=8,
+        num_logical_experts=8,
+        activation=MoEActivation.SILU,
+        device="cpu",
+        routing_method=RoutingMethodType.DeepSeekV3,
+        moe_parallel_config=FusedMoEParallelConfig(
+            tp_size=1,
+            pcp_size=1,
+            dp_size=1,
+            ep_size=1,
+            tp_rank=0,
+            pcp_rank=0,
+            dp_rank=0,
+            ep_rank=0,
+            sp_size=1,
+            use_ep=False,
+            all2all_backend="allgather_reducescatter",
+            enable_eplb=False,
+        ),
+        in_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+    )
+    quant_config = HummingLayerQuantizationConfig(
+        weight_schema=_mxfp6_weight_schema(),
+        input_schema=quant_key_to_input_schema(kMxfp8Dynamic),
+    )
+
+    captured = {}
+    real_select = humming_module.select_humming_moe_experts
+
+    def _spy(config, weight_key, activation_key):
+        captured["activation_key"] = activation_key
+        return real_select(
+            config=config, weight_key=weight_key, activation_key=activation_key
+        )
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(humming_module, "select_humming_moe_experts", _spy)
+    with (
+        patch(
+            "vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.humming.schema"
+            ".current_platform"
+        ) as platform_mock,
+        patch("humming.schema.humming.current_device", _Device()),
+    ):
+        platform_mock.get_device_capability.return_value = DeviceCapability(
+            capability // 10, capability % 10
+        )
+        HummingMoEMethod(quant_config, moe_config)
+
+    assert captured["activation_key"] == expect_fp8_key
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not has_humming(), reason="humming is not installed")
+def test_fp4_activation_still_deprecated_on_sm100(monkeypatch):
+    """Only FP8 is ungated: FP4 activations keep falling back on SM100."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+        kNvfp4Dynamic,
+    )
+
+    resolved = _resolve_input_schema(monkeypatch, 100, kNvfp4Dynamic)
+    assert resolved.a_dtype is None or resolved.a_dtype.num_bits != 4

@@ -646,6 +646,9 @@ def __init__(
             input_schema=self.force_input_schema or self.input_schema,
             param_dtype=moe.in_dtype,
             allow_fallback=quant_config.allow_input_schema_fallback,
+            # Keep the BF16 fallback on SM100-SM119 (see the MoE weight
+            # processing call site in utils/humming/moe.py).
+            allow_fp8_sm100=False,
         )
         activation_key = input_schema_to_quant_key(runtime_input_schema, moe.in_dtype)

@@ -503,6 +503,10 @@ def _process_single_sublayer(
